scope: Bounded Mac-only source/ownership investigation; no AGC/PCM implementation, no flight equations, ROM or supplied asset changes.

scope_decision.fifo_only_patch: Small and mechanically removable, but insufficient to establish faithful AGC/peripheral continuation.
scope_decision.complete_snapshot: Requires coherent per-instance engine auxiliary state, wrapper epoch rebasing, PCM interrupt timing and atomic checkpoint ownership across LM/CSM. This exceeds a narrow FIFO serializer; broad implementation paused.
scope_decision.equation_fork_needed: No equation changes indicated by this investigation. Ownership relocation changes existing same-class multi-vessel behavior and needs upstream-level regression coverage.
scope_decision.fallback: Use original uninterrupted PDI through the validated source-chart radar incorporation and P64 handoff. Label saves archival only for faithful-resume purposes. Stop at the existing handoff; no resumed ACA or landing claims.

verified_ownership.cmake: Separate agc_engine.c objects link into LEM.dylib and Saturn5.dylib; each dylib contains non-external CduFifos/CduChecker symbols.
verified_ownership.meaning: The normal LM/CSM pair has separate module-local queues. Multiple AGCs of the same vessel module share the static queues and pulse accumulators. This corrects the earlier process-global wording.
verified_ownership.probe: Exact existing helper calls confirm an increment enqueued for A is serviced into B.

new_snapshot_loading_contract: Version a complete extension within each original vessel AGC/PCM context; keep original legacy records. Stage parsed fields until the entire known version is valid, then restore CPU clock and pending work together.

For direct ring storage, validate exactly three FIFO records, 128 words per FIFO, Ptr in 0..127, Size in 0..128, IntervalType in 0..2, CduChecker in 0..2 and nonzero low 30-bit magnitude for active words. Preserve both high sign/rate bits with unsigned 32-bit wire encoding.

Use exact-width uint64 cycle/deadline representation. An overdue NextUpdate is legitimate pending work; do not force it to the future or discard it. Preserve original 13/13/14 and 213/213/214 scheduling and 128-entry overflow behavior.

Missing extension means legacy loading with a cold processor clock, queue and wrapper/PCM defaults; it remains loadable but cannot pass faithful-resume certification. Unknown, partial, duplicate or malformed extensions must not partially restore a counter and must fail the strict new-checkpoint capability check.

Take the per-instance CPU, auxiliary queues, wrapper timing and PCM phase at one completed frame boundary; quiesce/join any accelerated worker. Current cycle wrappers use agcCycleMutex, while guidance SaveState itself has no mutex guard.

Keep client pointers, mutexes, threads and ROM bytes outside the snapshot. Rebind client pointers on creation. Audit init/power-loss paths without introducing a new pulse-discard or hardware-reset policy.

Test two same-module AGCs plus the original LM/CSM scenario, repeated load order, independent construction/destruction, sign/rate switches, ring wrap/full queue, overdue deadlines, nonzero gyro/coarse residuals, worker checkpoint timing and older saves.

Require exact zero-step restoration and paired continued traces beyond the existing 31 samples; exercise at least two 1.28-second display periods, multiple 20ms DOWNRUPT frames and the 75ms coarse burst period. Require full pending-state equality separately from bounded SDK-decimal instrument observers.

candidate_two_count_difference.verified: At ticks 28..30, uninterrupted forward CDU is 334 and resumed is 336. Lateral values agree at -5. Both original pointer filters propagate the changed target.
candidate_two_count_difference.filter_explanation: Original 0.5571 ft/s per CDU count, display factor 0.1 and gain 1.5*(1/60)*5=0.125 turn two counts into 0.0139275, 0.0261140625 and 0.0367773046875 display-unit differences over three steps, matching the recorded rounding.
candidate_two_count_difference.distinct_rounding: Tick 7 pointer text differs by 1e-6 with equal raw CDU counts, consistent with six-decimal serialization/observer precision. No tolerance was relaxed.
candidate_two_count_difference.causality: Unisolated. Direct native IMU read paths bypass FIFO enqueueing; no runtime FIFO occupancy was captured at the original handoff. CPU fractional cycle phase and external PCM DOWNRUPT phase are additional candidates, not established causes.
